The '''Dreighton system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[Dreighton Nebula/Legends|Dreighton Nebula]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dreighton]].
